prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong Denver-area option for hail repair based on the available results: it specializes in storm and hail damage, reports a 4.9-star rating across 353+ Google reviews, and says it is a licensed general contractor. It’s based in Lakewood and serves Denver. [Gates hail repair](https://www.gatesroof.com/services/storm-hail-damage/denver) · [Denver reviews](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d still get **at least two written estimates** before choosing. Verify the contractor’s current local license and insurance, ask for nearby hail-repair references, and don’t sign under pressure or pay in full upfront. The Colorado Roofing Association also warns against door-to-door storm solicitors and deductible-waiver offers. [Consumer guidance](https://www.coloradoroofing.org/consumer/no-roof-scams)
